summary: Churchill Capital Corp XI filed an 8-K announcing the SEC declared effective its Form S-4 (File No. 333-298781) for the previously disclosed June 24, 2026 merger with Agility Robotics, Inc., with BLB Merger Sub, Inc. as merger subsidiary. An extraordinary general meeting is set for November 2, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET at Willkie Farr & Gallagher, with a virtual option. The proxy statement/prospectus covers the de-SPAC business combination. No price, premium, or stake terms appear in the excerpt. Watch redemption levels, vote outcome, and closing conditions.
